title: coumarouna polyphylla
intro: Coumarouna polyphylla, commonly known as Copaiba, is a plant native to the Amazon rainforest in South America, belonging to the family Meliaceae. Copaiba is known for its medicinal properties and has been used for centuries in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Copaiba include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in soothing skin irritations, reducing pain, and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Copaiba include diterpenic resin, specifically beta-bisabolol, which is responsible for its therapeutic effects and has been used to treat conditions such as wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues.
